item.title: US embassy in Baghdad attacked as Iraq pulled deeper into Mideast war
item.summary: A drone and rocket attack targeted the US embassy in Baghdad early Tuesday, while a strike killed four people at a house reportedly hosting Iranian advisors, security officials said, pulling Iraq deeper into the Middle East war.

item.title: 'Near universal refusal' - European leaders reject Trump's demand for Strait of Hormuz mission
item.summary: NATO allies and other Western nations pushed back Monday on US President Donald Trump's demand that military alliance members help reopen the Strait of Hormuz, the critical conduit for crude oil Iran has effectively closed. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Brussels
